option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific lung pathology (organizing pneumonia) as a consequence of COVID-19, which is not directly related to Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
The option describes persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection in an immunocompromised patient, which is a clinical course of COVID-19, not Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
The option describes SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia, which is the primary infection, not Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
The option describes COVID-19 pneumonia, which is the primary infection, not Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).
